# refresh-client (C6.3, from i-mux's agent bar): -S redraws a client's status line and no flag
# the whole client; with no client to refresh, it fails.
conf status.conf
size 60x10
run new-session -d -s a 'exec cat'
run refresh-client -S
run refresh-client
client c 60x10
run set -g status-right '[#{@mark}]' ; set -g @mark one
run refresh-client -S
screen c
run set -g @mark two ; refresh-client
screen c
run refresh-client -S -t nosuch
run kill-server
